---
title: "Publications"
subtitle: "Peer-reviewed papers"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(htmltools)

publication <- function(year, title, authors, venue, doi, summary = NULL,
                        page = NULL, code = NULL, img = NULL) {
  tags$article(
    class = "pub-item",
    if (!is.null(img)) tags$img(src = img, alt = "", class = "pub-image"),
    tags$div(
      class = "pub-body",
      tags$p(year, class = "pub-year"),
      tags$h3(title, class = "pub-title"),
      tags$p(HTML(authors), class = "pub-authors"),
      tags$p(tags$em(venue), class = "pub-venue"),
      if (!is.null(summary)) tags$p(summary, class = "pub-summary"),
      tags$div(
        class = "pub-links",
        tags$a("Read paper", href = paste0("https://doi.org/", doi),
               target = "_blank", rel = "noopener", class = "publication-button"),
        if (!is.null(page)) tags$a("Project summary", href = page, class = "pub-link"),
        if (!is.null(code)) tags$a("Code on GitHub", href = code,
                                   target = "_blank", rel = "noopener", class = "pub-link"),
        tags$span(paste0("doi:", doi), class = "pub-doi")
      )
    )
  )
}
```
